title: Walk in His Will
speaker: Pastor Josh Smith
takeaway: Walking in God's will means living out his eternal purpose — pursuing unity under Christ, living for the praise of his glory, keeping in step with the sealing Spirit, and resting in the confidence that he will complete his good work.

blocks.text: "With all wisdom and understanding, he made known to us the mystery of his will according to his good pleasure, which he purposed in Christ, to be put into effect when the times reach their fulfillment—to bring unity to all things in heaven and on earth under Christ." -Ephesians 1:8b-10

"I have given them the glory that you gave me, that they may be one as we are one— I in them and you in me—so that they may be brought to complete unity. Then the world will know that you sent me and have loved them even as you have loved me." -John 17:22-23

"In him we were also chosen, having been predestined according to the plan of him who works out everything in conformity with the purpose of his will, in order that we, who were the first to put our hope in Christ, might be for the praise of his glory." -Ephesians 1:11-12

"And you also were included in Christ when you heard the message of truth, the gospel of your salvation. When you believed, you were marked in him with a seal, the promised Holy Spirit." -Ephesians 1:13
3 Truths About Walking by the Holy Spirit

The Holy Spirit was promised: "I will give you a new heart and put a new spirit in you; I will remove from you your heart of stone and give you a heart of flesh. And I will put my Spirit in you and move you to follow my decrees and be careful to keep my laws." -Ezekiel 36:26-27

Every Christian is sealed by the Spirit: For those who are led by the Spirit of God are the children of God." -Romans 8:14 · The Spirit you received does not make you slaves, so that you live in fear again; rather, the Spirit you received brought about your adoption to sonship. And by him we cry, "Abba, Father." -Romans 8:15
Keep in step with the Spirit daily: "The mind governed by the flesh is death, but the mind governed by the Spirit is life and peace." -Romans 8:6
"The promised Holy Spirit, who is a deposit guaranteeing our inheritance until the redemption of those who are God's possession—to the praise of his glory." -Ephesians 1:13b-14
"Being confident of this, that He who began a good work in you will carry it on to completion until the day of Christ Jesus." -Philippians 1:6
